changeSet.author: nexus-6pbwx
changeSet.comment: Helper functions for the nexus-6pbwx owner rule, all SECURITY INVOKER so the caller's tenant policy applies: nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(tenant, segment), nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(tenant, owner_id) (not tumbler-shaped, or a curator's), and nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner(tenant, collection): the owner segment (first two dot-segments of the tumbler, hyphenated) of the live documents in a collection, non-curator owners first, then the owner with the most documents, then the lower segment; NULL when no live document has an owner-address tumbler.

changeSet.author: nexus-6pbwx
changeSet.comment: Triggers that apply the nexus-6pbwx owner rule wherever it can arrive: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF owner_id, content_type on catalog_collections, and AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF physical_collection, deleted_at on catalog_documents. Both SECURITY INVOKER, both NOTICE when they rewrite an owner. Locks catalog_documents then catalog_collections (the document trigger's runtime order) under a 5s lock_timeout. No existing row changes here; catalog-044-3 repairs those.
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; LOCK TABLE nexus.catalog_documents, nexus.catalog_collections IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE;

changeSet.author: nexus-6pbwx
changeSet.comment: nexus-6pbwx: one-off repair of existing code/docs/rdr collection rows whose owner_id is replaceable (not tumbler-shaped: a slug, "default", a tenant-id placeholder; or a curator-type owner's segment) and that have live documents: owner_id becomes the owner segment of those documents, by the same nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner the triggers use. Rows without documents, knowledge rows and quarantine rows are untouched. DATA EFFECT: UPDATEs catalog_collections.owner_id for every code/docs/rdr row whose owner_id does not match ^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*$, or names a curator-type owner, and that has at least one live catalog_documents row with a three-segment numeric tumbler whose derived owner differs from the stored one; reversible in effect only, no rollback SQL (see the rollback note).
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; LOCK TABLE nexus.catalog_documents, nexus.catalog_owners, nexus.catalog_collections IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
